items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Abby was talking like you said then the union makes them use ten now.

ctx.x: They used to call them a tunk band, they'd put them way in the back. What'd they call them? Tunk bands.

You know like hunky tunk. Hunky tunk bands, yeah. Well I wanted to ask too while I met it, Abby played a parade two weeks ago and he was saying over those days, several years ago when you had your little six piece band or something like that, a brass band, you got a lot of more jobs on the street and it sounded good and all too. Did you only use about six or seven pieces in the street at one time or not? No. Abby was talking like you said then the union makes them use ten now.
